{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the distribution of the 'channel' column
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of 'converted' by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel:\n", conversion_by_channel)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
email_rate = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_rate = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
